description: The VP of Softball champions the growth and health of the GNGRLL softball program across all divisions (7-8, 9-10, 11-12, and 12-16). This role drives recruitment, plans softball-specific clinics and team formation, staffs softball program roles (equipment, concessions, media, scheduler), and runs a parent discussion group to build faster pathways for softball success. The VP coordinates interleague and District/high school opportunities, enforces softball safety rules (face masks required for all infield positions), and represents softball interests to the board on scheduling, fields, uniforms, and equipment.

calendar.title: Softball parent discussion group meeting (bi-weekly)
calendar.description: Recurring softball parent/board discussion group covering officer roles, coming-season scheduling and travel, field improvements, equipment, uniforms, and District/high school game opportunities. Open to all softball parents to build pathways for softball success and equitability.

calendar.title: Softball program improvements & recruitment planning
calendar.description: Post-season review of the softball program: identify improvement areas, recruitment strategies to grow enrollment across divisions, and any division mergers with neighboring leagues (e.g., Majors softball with Yarmouth) when counts are low.

calendar.title: Softball program planning - recruitment, clinics, team formation
calendar.description: Winter planning for softball: recruitment push, Julie Roy winter softball clinic coordination, and preliminary team formation across softball divisions ahead of assessments.

calendar.title: Softball uniform & equipment needs (girl's cut) input
calendar.description: Provide softball-specific input to uniform and equipment coordinators: girl's cut jerseys, softball-sized balls, catcher's gear, and required infield face masks for all softball positions.

calendar.title: Memorial Day Parade participation
calendar.description: Organize softball teams' participation in the Memorial Day parade - line up players, coordinate banners and route logistics with the board.

calendar.title: Memorial Day parade - softball turnout
calendar.description: Confirm softball division turnout for the parade and coordinate with information officer and grounds for staging.

calendar.title: Softball program roles staffing
calendar.description: Recruit and confirm softball program staff for the coming year: VP Softball, Softball Equipment, Softball Concessions, Media, and Scheduler. Fill open seats ahead of board elections.

tasks.title: Draft softball program improvement & recruitment plan
tasks.description: Coming off the season, write up softball program improvements and a recruitment plan to grow numbers by division; flag any low-count divisions that may need interleague merger (e.g., Yarmouth softball, Windham Juniors).

tasks.title: Coordinate winter softball clinics (Julie Roy)
tasks.description: Work with the president on scheduling the Julie Roy winter softball clinic - dates, gym space, age-group slots, session fees ($10/session or 4 for $30), and budget (~$2,600-$2,800, expected to break even).

tasks.title: Plan softball team formation & assessments
tasks.description: Coordinate softball assessment stations, judges, and preliminary team formation across the 7-8, 9-10, 11-12, and 12-16 divisions ahead of the spring draft.

tasks.title: Submit softball uniform & equipment requirements
tasks.description: Give uniform and equipment coordinators softball specifics: girl's cut jerseys, softball-sized balls, catcher's gear, and league face masks required for all infield positions per the 2017 safety rule.

tasks.title: Launch softball parent discussion group
tasks.description: Kick off the bi-weekly softball parent/board discussion group; invite all softball parents, collect agenda items, and set the recurring meeting cadence and platform.

tasks.title: Organize Memorial Day parade softball participation
tasks.description: Line up softball teams for the Memorial Day parade - notify families, coordinate banners, and confirm staging/route with the board.

tasks.title: Coordinate District / high school softball game opportunities
tasks.description: Pursue interleague, District 6, and high school game/scrimmage opportunities to give softball players competitive reps and visibility.

tasks.title: Staff softball program roles for next year
tasks.description: Recruit and confirm VP Softball, Softball Equipment, Softball Concessions, Media, and Scheduler positions; report the slate ahead of board elections.
